questions.q: We walk by faith, Paul says, rather than by what?
questions.evidence: for we walk by faith, not by sight

questions.q: In what does Paul say we have this treasure?
questions.evidence: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves

questions.q: If anyone is in Christ, what is he?
questions.evidence: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation

questions.q: What kind of giver does God love?
questions.evidence: for God loves a cheerful giver

questions.q: How many times does Paul say he suffered shipwreck?
What was given to Paul, a messenger of Satan to torment him?
questions.evidence: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively

questions.q: What did the Lord tell Paul was sufficient for him?
questions.evidence: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness
